findings.nextMinimumValidation: Topology wall-clock flush followed by a later-sequence trade for that closed bucket; duplicate/retry/restart idempotence; failed-DB retry; old-version upsert rejection; all higher periods receive replacement without double-counting; reconcile repaired exact historical buckets and fresh closed candles against committed trades.
